description:
DAILY DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES: 

 • UNDER LIMITED SUPERVISION, ASSIST THE SCJD CMS APPLICATION TEAM WITH DEVELOPMENT, DEPLOYMENT AND SUPPORT OF SOFTWARE TO SUPPORT ELECTRONIC CITATION AND DISPOSITION REPORTING (E-TICKETING). 
 • DEVELOP DATA INTERFACES WITH SCDMV TO IMPORT CITATION DATA INTO CMS. 
 • UPDATE EXISTING DISPOSITION REPORTING INTERFACE SERVICE AS NEEDED. 
 • DEVELOP A WEB PORTAL THAT ALLOWS COURTS TO RETRIEVE CITATION DATA FROM SCDMV AND REPORT DISPOSITIONS TO SCDMV. 
 • PROVIDE SUPPORT AND PROBLEM SOLVING ASSISTANCE ON QUESTIONS AND ISSUES ARISING FROM THE E-TICKETING. 
 • DEPLOY AND PROVIDE INSTALLATION SUPPORT TO COUNTIES. 
 • PROVIDE KNOWLEDGE TRANSFER AND DOCUMENTATION RELATED TO THE DESIGN, DEPLOYMENT AND SUPPORT OF INTERFACE SOFTWARE 
 • WORK WITH COUNTY PERSONNEL IN ORDER TO SUPPORT E-TICKETING APPLICATIONS 




 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
